difference: Old C copied a single arc/star profile; old A duplicated two single-sided raw profiles, with presets C and A and finals A/C and E/A. This E design compares inner versus outer zigzag pairs at two levels of reflection: each E component is itself a full double-sided completion, and the two components are then duplicated about the global fold. It is a completion-then-duplication misconception, not the prior raw-profile-copy mechanism. No source arc or source star is colored, no full E circular contour is colored, and the existing seam/contact stays unaltered. Prior refinement only considered A-to-B direction swap, arc recolor and new seam; none is used here.
